Tests that v8.compile and v8.produceCache trace events report code cache usage for scripts stored in Service Worker Cache Storage.

--- Trace events while installing -------------
v8.compile: {
    columnNumber : 1
    lineNumber : 1
    notStreamedReason : <string>
    streamed : <boolean>
    url : .../inspector-protocol/service-worker/resources/v8-cache-worker.js
}
v8.compile: {
    columnNumber : 1
    eager : true
    lineNumber : 1
    notStreamedReason : <string>
    streamed : <boolean>
    url : .../devtools/resources/v8-cache-script.js
}
v8.produceCache: {
    columnNumber : 1
    lineNumber : 1
    producedCacheSize : <number>
    url : .../devtools/resources/v8-cache-script.js
}
-----------------------------------------------
--- Trace events while executing scripts ------

    cacheKind : full
    cacheRejected : false
    columnNumber : 1
    consumedCacheSize : <number>
    lineNumber : 1
    notStreamedReason : <string>
    streamed : <boolean>
    url : .../devtools/resources/v8-cache-script.js
}
v8.compile: {
    cacheKind : full
    cacheRejected : false
    columnNumber : 1
    consumedCacheSize : <number>
    lineNumber : 1
    notStreamedReason : <string>
    streamed : <boolean>
    url : .../devtools/resources/v8-cache-script.js
}
